issue.title: RedirectResponse returns 404 for external url's with TestClient

issue.body:
I played with [this](https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/master/tests/test_responses.py#L60) test case by redirecting to an external URL and it seems to fail when a trailing slash is missing and `allow_redirects` is set to `True` (which is the default).

The same is true if you append any path parameter or query parameter to the URL.

It fails for starlette 0.12.13 and 0.13.

The error I receive is:

```
            if len(resp.history) >= self.max_redirects:
>               raise TooManyRedirects('Exceeded %s redirects.' % self.max_redirects, response=resp)
E               requests.exceptions.TooManyRedirects: Exceeded 30 redirects.
```

This is my test:

```python
def test_redirect_response():
    url: str = 'https://github.com'

    async def app(scope, receive, send):
        if scope["path"] == "/":
            response = Response("hello, world", media_type="text/plain")
        else:
            response = RedirectResponse(url=url)
        await response(scope, receive, send)

    client = TestClient(app)

    response = client.get("/redirect", allow_redirects=False)
    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_307_TEMPORARY_REDIRECT

    response = client.get("/redirect")
    assert response.status_code == status.HTTP_200_OK

```

To me, it seems to be an issue with the TestClient as it actually works when running a server and return a RedirectResponse.
